# Support

Thanks for using IoT Hunter! Here's how to get help.

## Documentation

Start with:

- [README.md](README.md) — installation, usage, scan profiles, and troubleshooting notes
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to contribute code, docs, or tests
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — responsible-disclosure policy for vulnerabilities in the tool itself

## Questions and Discussions

For usage questions, ideas, and general discussion, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/iot-hunter/discussions) (if enabled) or open a GitHub issue using the appropriate template.

## Bug Reports and Feature Requests

- **Bugs:** Open an issue using the **Bug report** template
- **Features:** Open an issue using the **Feature request** template

Please sanitize logs and screenshots before posting — remove private IP addresses, MAC addresses, hostnames, credentials, and device identifiers.

## Security Issues

Do **not** open a public issue for vulnerabilities in IoT Hunter itself. Report privately:

- **Maintainer / Developer:** Harsh Saini — cyber.h4rsh@zohomail.in

## Project and Collaboration Queries

For partnership, collaboration, or organizational queries:

- **Manager:** Prachi Sharma — manager.prachi@zohomail.in
- **Organization:** MR Cyber Pulse

## Response Expectations

This is a community-maintained project. Response times vary, but security reports are prioritized. Please be patient and avoid pinging maintainers on multiple channels for the same issue.
